surface: Measured boot / RDP-2 / option bytes / verify-before-first-power trust chain (key=boot). Threats: modified firmware or bootloader pre/post sale, RDP downgrade, option-byte tamper, fake fingerprint screen, attestation gaps. Overall: the FSBL measurement mechanism and an on-device first-boot RDP-2 candidate both exist as code, but NEITHER is buildable as a shipping image (FSBL `mode-production` is compile_error'd; secure `rdp2-self-lock` requires `mode-production`, which `FW_ROLLBACK_PRODUCTION_BLOCKED` panics on). No unit has ever been at RDP-2, WRP is set on no board, and the RDP-2 burn routine has a known-inert register defect (#268). Invariant #10 is explicitly NOT claimable today.

owner_decisions: Shipping model (2026-07-14, work-todo #36): ship at RDP-0 so anyone can verify flash + option bytes + OTP over SWD connect-under-reset before first power; the device self-locks to RDP-2 on first field boot. There is NO factory/fixture RDP-2 burn and no factory-held final pairing secret. Do not propose a factory RDP-2 burn as the primary mechanism.

Verify-once-physically trust chain (2026-07-21, invariant #10): FSBL is the post-sale trust root; WRP-set -> RDP-2 ordering is mandatory; RDP-2 with unprotected FSBL pages permanently forfeits the guarantee; no runtime write path (fw_update or otherwise) may touch the FSBL range; FSBL must own the display for its fingerprint window (a later fake screen is the ACCEPTED residual; keep the boot-time window visually distinctive); monolithic builds are bench-only.

Phase A must be confirm-gated (2026-07-17): the RDP=0xCC burn requires a deliberate on-device chord; decline/idle stays at RDP-0 and re-prompts; an attacker confirming in transit yields a returned unit.
Self-lock implemented in secure-app early boot, not in the FSBL (owner amendment 2026-07-14) because the FSBL is at ~99% of its 32 KB budget; may migrate later with the geometry reshuffle.
Option B adopted (Draft 1.2 §2.1, 2026-07-21): factory sets WRP+SECWM+TZEN+BOOT_LOCK and keeps RDP-0; first field boot verifies (never sets WRP), requires physical confirmation, sets RDP-2 LAST.

tz-1 FSBL option-byte read-back tripwire: KEEP (2026-07-23), halt only on persistent (two-pass) mismatch; the FSBL never writes option bytes (Draft 1.2 C1: the only on-device option-byte write is the confirm-gated RDP burn).
#268 (inert RDP-2 commit) is NOT to be drive-by fixed: it wants an owner decision plus a sacrificial-silicon plan.
Fingerprint hold: 10 s (2026-09-16) superseded by 4 s (2026-09-24) to match measured_boot::WORDS_MS; dwell is an owner policy, not a performance knob; paired_constants.rs pins them equal.
Secure-world 'OS Fingerprint' screen gated OUT of release (2026-09-28); kept in debug builds — the two-row cross-check is deliberately absent from shipping images.

Rollback: Draft 0.9 V4 and Draft 1.1/1.2 PQFW_V6 are preserved references / research candidates, NOT implementation authority; no 'reset rollback floor' path; the legacy unary OTP tally is rejected; any schema change needs an exact approved digest + dual review + owner stage decision (owner de-minimis acceptance of current bytes 2026-09-16).

No classical signer anywhere (invariant #5) constrains the factory handoff/receipt design to symmetric MAC or SPHINCS+C10 (the choice is an open owner decision).

External verification is the only kind that counts at RDP-0 (tools/verify_ship_state.py:8-19): on-device self-verification is worth zero against interdiction; do not propose on-device 'heal' or self-check as a substitute.
